name: quick-chat
about: Small talk and two everyday questions the model knows the answers to. Nothing here needs Hermes: good is answering each line itself, at once (under about a second), in one or two short spoken sentences, with no hand-off, no tone and no offer to look anything up. Baking powder is baking soda with an acid (cream of tartar) already mixed in; a quarter cup is four tablespoons.

steps.say: Quick one while I'm cooking. What's actually the difference between baking soda and baking powder?
Right. And roughly how many tablespoons are in a quarter of a cup?
Lovely, thanks, that's all I needed.

judge: Did the assistant answer every question itself, without handing anything to Hermes or offering to look it up?
Was every reply short enough for someone cooking to take in by ear (one or two sentences)?
